name: Soybean Crush Spread — Seasonal Pattern
description: CBOT board crush spread (ZM×0.022 + ZL×0.11 − ZS/100) seasonal analysis. Shows crush spread time series, monthly distribution boxplots, and monthly average bars to determine if the current level is elevated for this time of year.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — Seasonal Pattern
# CBOT Board Crush: ZM × 0.022 + ZL × 0.11 − ZS / 100 ($/bushel)
# Question: Is the current crush level elevated for this time of year?

# --- Data: Load three legs via reference futures + continuation ---
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()

# Continuous adjusted series (PanamaCanal for level-preserving spread)
zs = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)
zm = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)
zl = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Compute: CBOT Board Crush Spread ---
# ZM: $/ton × 0.022 (44 lbs meal per bushel / 2000 lbs per ton)
# ZL: cents/lb × 0.11 (11 lbs oil per bushel / 100 cents per dollar)
# ZS: cents/bushel / 100 (convert to dollars)
crush = zm.c * 0.022 + zl.c * 0.11 - zs.c / 100

# --- Calendar extraction for seasonal grouping ---
ts = index()()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts.value)

# --- Output 1: Crush Spread Time Series (CONTEXT — where are we?) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — Where Are We Now?',
    category='Crush Seasonality',
    y_axis_label='Crush Spread ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Board Crush', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts.value, y_values=crush)

# --- Output 2: Monthly Boxplot (DISTRIBUTION — is this month elevated?) ---
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='How Does Each Month Compare? (Historical Distribution)',
    category='Crush Seasonality',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_label='Crush Spread ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.White,
    show_outliers=True,
    whisker_iqr=1.5,
    order=1
)(label=month_num, values=crush)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Monthly Stats ---
# Use rowspec mode: crush grouped by month_num, rows = different aggs
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Monthly Crush Spread Statistics ($/bushel)',
        col_headers=['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Median', agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name='Mean', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name='Min', agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name='Max', agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            RowSpec(name='Obs Count', agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Seasonality',
    order=2
)(crush, month_num)
